title: Import, Export, and Interchange Packages
negative_results: a private token in a point label or in imported package text is refused
malformed JSON, a wrong CSV header, a non-cw:// URI, and an empty package all fail safely as typed InterchangeError
an empty bundle is refused at build time

claims.statement: A single interchange bundle round-trips a batch of declared points across JSON, GeoJSON, KML, CSV, and CW-URI and imports back to the same points; each point carries its CRS + epoch; the bundle records provenance and a content hash and is privacy-scanned on build, export, and import (POWER).

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic points only; every label and serialized text privacy-scanned; reuses io_geo + share; no geographic meaning attached to any source vector
